title: Configure MCP Servers for Coding Agents
trigger: User wants to connect a coding agent to OpenKaava's tools

steps.action: Click the sliders glyph in the status bar at the bottom to open Settings
Toggle on the servers you want (e.g., Echo server or future Schematify server)
Leave Write .mcp.json into open projects on; this generates or updates the .mcp.json file
Open a terminal in the OpenKaava cluster (Ctrl+Shift+`) and start your MCP client (e.g., Claude Code) there
When the client starts, it reads .mcp.json and connects to the enabled servers using the KAAVA_MCP_PORT and KAAVA_MCP_TOKEN environment variables

outcome: MCP servers are enabled and written to .mcp.json, making OpenKaava's tools available to agents in the terminal
